subject: Islamiat
q: Sunan Ibn Majah ke musannif kaun hain?
explanation: Sunan Ibn Majah ke musannif Muhammad bin Yazid Ibn Majah hain.

subject: Islamiat
q: Hanbali mazhab ke bani kaun hain?
explanation: Hanbali mazhab ke bani Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal hain.

subject: Islamiat
q: Data Ganj Bakhsh (Ali Hujwiri) ka mazar kis sheher me hai?
explanation: Data Ganj Bakhsh ka mazar Lahore me hai.

subject: Islamiat
q: Hazrat Moinuddin Chishti ka mazar kahan hai?
explanation: Moinuddin Chishti ka mazar Ajmer (India) me hai.

subject: Islamiat
q: Ibn Arabi ki mashhoor kitab kaun si hai?
explanation: Ibn Arabi ki mashhoor kitab Futuhat al-Makkiyya hai.

subject: Islamiat
q: Ibn Sina ko kis laqab se jana jata hai?
explanation: Ibn Sina ko Sheikh al-Rais (sheikhs ka sardar) kehte hain.
